t: You're standing by the statue of Richard Cobden, a Grade II listed monument on Camden High Street, close to Mornington Crescent tube station. Cobden was a British Radical and Liberal politician and manufacturer. He campaigned for free trade and for peace, and he is associated with the Anti-Corn Law League and the Cobden–Chevalier Treaty. The statue shows him as a prominent figure in those causes, and it sits right on the busy high street.
